title: Mutations ignore `DEFAULT_PK_FIELD_NAME`: `_parse_pk` looks up by `pk=` instead of the configured key
author: ayushin
body_preview: ## Describe the bug  `DEFAULT_PK_FIELD_NAME` lets a project use a field other than the Django primary key as the GraphQL identifier (e.g. a `uuid`/`slug`/external id, or a virtual id field such as `django-sqids`). **Filters honor it** (`filters.apply` resolves the configured field), but **mutations do not**.
